scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @inventory-ops/api & npm run dev -w @inventory-ops/web
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @inventory-ops/api && npm run build -w @inventory-ops/api
scripts.start:api:prod: npm run prisma:push -w @inventory-ops/api && npm run start -w @inventory-ops/api
